about: Builder options whose meaning or default changed, by AmiWind version (tools/build_recipe.py, docs/BUILD_RECIPES.md). A recipe from an older version is built with a warning that lists every change since its version. change: added (with its default "to"), default (from -> to), meaning, retired (tools/retired_flags.py) or removed. A null default means the builder decides (the build defaults file or the option's own rule). "current" is this builder's defaults: tests/test_build_recipe.py fails when they differ, so a changed default or a new option is recorded here first (python tools/build_recipe.py snapshot prints the block).
